# 1. Byzantine Stratiotai Phalanx country eligibility
oe_war2_is_byz_phalanx_country = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
	}
}

		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
	}
}

# 3. Steppe Mangudai Banner country eligibility
oe_war2_is_steppe_mangudai_country = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = YUA
		has_or_had_tag = GLH
		has_or_had_tag = OIR
		has_or_had_tag = CHG
		has_or_had_tag = TIM
		has_or_had_tag = MCH
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:steppe_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:tatar_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group
			}
		}
	}
}

# 5. Spanish Tercio & Pike-and-Shot doctrine sphere
oe_war2_is_tercio_doctrine_country = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = SPA
		has_or_had_tag = CAS
		has_or_had_tag = HAB
		has_or_had_tag = FRA
		has_or_had_tag = SWI
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_culture_group = culture_group:iberian_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:german_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:swiss_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group
			}
		}
	}
}

# 6. Line-infantry volley era (Absolutism / Revolutions)
oe_war2_is_line_volley_era = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
	army_size >= 15
}

# 7. Country possesses at least one transferable non-priceless work of art
oe_war2_has_plunderable_manuscript = {
	any_work_of_art_in_country = {
		art_is_priceless = no
	}
}

# 8. Maritime treaty power
oe_war2_is_maritime_treaty_power = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_of_ports >= 3
	OR = {
		navy_size >= 15
		has_markets = yes
	}
}
